title: Anthropic Is Giving Devs 6 Months of Claude Max for Free
description:
Comment MAX for the application link.

Anthropic gives 10,000 open source devs 6 months of Claude Max free — $1,200 value.

Need a GitHub repo with 5,000+ stars or an npm package with 1M+ monthly downloads, plus activity in the last 3 months.

Deadline: June 30, 2026.
